definition: A method from cooperative game theory adapted to machine learning to fairly attribute a model's prediction to the contribution of each individual input feature.
details: Shapley values (as used in tools like SHAP) provide a theoretically grounded way to explain individual model predictions by quantifying how much each feature contributed relative to a baseline.
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. Boil it down and it is this: A method from cooperative game theory adapted to machine learning to fairly attribute a model's prediction to the contribution of each individual input feature. Here is why it matters: Shapley values (as used in tools like SHAP) provide a theoretically grounded way to explain individual model predictions by quantifying how much each feature contributed relative to a baseline. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” That deliberate caution is Shapley Values.

citation.title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions
